product_results.description: Product Description: Mint-X® Rodent Repellent Trash Bags are the only EPA registered and patented rodent repellent trash bags in the world. Using a blend of plant-derived mint oils, Mint-X® Rodent Repellent Trash Bags are designed to smell fresh when used inside the home and keep rodents and raccoons away when outside for trash collection. The EPA registration ensures that Mint-X® Rodent Repellent Trash Bags are effective at repelling rodents and raccoons from the trash, while being entirely safe for humans and pets. And now, the plastic strength is stronger than ever with MintFlex® flexible bag technology!Mint-X offers a solution to all businesses that are challenged with maintaining sanitary conditions. Mint-X will eliminate rats, rodents and other pests from basements, curbsides and alleys of apartment buildings keeping tenants confident in management's ability to maintain a clean building. Mint-X trash bags can help keep the public parks beautiful by preventing rats, rodents and other pests from spreading garbage and disease where people are sitting, playing and eating. Any company engaged in food processing and preparation can benefit from making sure that rats, rodents and other vermin will not penetrate the trash bags while waiting for sanitation pick up. Any large complex like schools, universities, prisons, corporations that serves hundreds or thousands of meals per day must contain their garbage to prevent exposure to rats, rodents, raccoons and other pests that penetrate trash bags. The bag is 100 percent safe to handle just like a regular trash bag. Measures 1ft 11 ¾ inches X 2ft 1 inch.

STRONG AND DURABLE: Mint-X's Tall Kitchen trash bags feature Mint-Flex superior stretching technology making them an ideal choice for both every day and serious clean-ups in your home with easy-to-use drawstring
NEUTRALIZES ODORS: These trash bags are made with the highest-quality mint essential oils that neutralize odors keeping your kitchen smelling fresh, while naturally repelling any unwanted pests

FREE OF CHEMICALS & TOXINS: Mint-X trash bags are made with the highest quality food grade, mint essential oils to naturally and effectively keep pesky wildofe out of your trash while being completely safe for humans and pets

summary.text: Customers find these waste bags easy to use and appreciate their pleasant smell and quality, with one noting they hold a good amount of waste. The size receives mixed feedback - while some say they're the right size for their containers, others find them too large for trash can openings. The effectiveness against pests is mixed, with some saying they keep rodents away while others report they don't deter raccoons. The value for money and fit also receive mixed reviews, with some finding them worth the money while others consider them expensive.
